7/8″ Corrugated

Metal Roofing, Wall and Interior Panel

Known to provide exceptional strength and durability, 7/8″ Corrugated Metal Wall & Interior Panels have a repeating wave pattern that offer a visual appeal to any Commercial or Residential project.

Available with an optional anti-siphon channel for added water protection allowing for single overlaps and better coverage per panel.

Specifications

  • 32″ coverage in 26 and 24 gauge steel
  • Standard lengths are 4’ to 40’
  • Comes in a wide choice of attractive colours, Galvanized Plus or Galvalume Plus material
  • Low slope capability to 2/12
  • Architectural design flexibility
